relation_kinds.translation: proposed translation correspondence; not a certified dictionary sense

editorial_review.scope: All 27 verses reread in both pinned texts.
notes: Gen 17:1,12,17,24–25: nominal age idioms grouped separately from individual numeric units.
Gen 17:4: the French supplied relative predicate is contextual, not a lexical rendering of the independent Hebrew pronoun.
Gen 17:11,14,23–25: the LSG omits or compresses explicit flesh/foreskin terminology in several occurrences; preserve each original ID contextually without manufacturing a separate French term.
Gen 17:12–13: birth/household and monetary acquisition constructions keep the source terms distinct.
Gen 17:17–19: interrogative and optative expressions and separate Isaac/laughter occurrences are not treated as identical lexical forms.
editorial_review.limitations: Both passes performed by the same editor; no independent dictionary-sense verification; publication checks deferred.
